page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across most compute and memory metrics. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is recorded at 1865.39, while multi-core performance reaches 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. In database operations, the instance achieves a PassMark database score of 13455.54 and handles 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second. Notably, text generation for a small 135M LLM model shows strong performance at 282.15 tokens per second, though larger 7B model text generation drops to an average of 17.54 tokens per second.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.r7.8xlarge is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external storage configurations for persistent data. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance provides a dense memory allocation relative to its 32 dedicated cores, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases like Redis, enterprise database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale language model inference.
